changelog:
- Complete Opera-Grade Light Theme: Overhauled every dialog, sheet, and screen across the browser with clean pearl backgrounds (#FAF9F6/#F8FAFC), crisp dark slate typography (#0F172A), and subtle borders (#E2E8F0).
- Universal Sheet Light Theming: Added recursive light theme engine across all sheets (Fokk AI, General Settings, Shield Settings, Vault Settings, Media Settings, About Community, Extensions Manager, History, Tab Switcher, Saved Summaries, Privacy Account, and VPN).
- Fokk AI Light Mode: Interactive Ask AI, Takeaway bullets, Key Metrics, and Reality Audit now feature custom light bubbles (#E0F2FE), cards (#FFFFFF), and composer docks with high-contrast text.
- Home Speed Dials & Shortcuts: Fixed dial card light CSS styling to display clean white cards with proper title and URL contrast.
- Internal HTML Pages: Added full light theme support to Fokk Pro & Contributing (fokk_contributing.html), About page (fokk_about.html), and WebTorrent streamer (fokk_webtorrent.html) synchronized with native theme state.
- Tab Switcher Light Mode: Tab cards and bottom sheet container adapt seamlessly to light theme with high-contrast card headers and active borders.
